top_choice_rationale: P001 (Kane, Mele, Molenkamp) is a checkable chain of Z2 prediction with time-reversal-protected helical edge states followed by first observation of quantised edge transport in HgTe wells, confirmed for over fifteen years by transport, ARPES and STM, so the interpretation is settled. The Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang and 3D topological-insulator omissions are real but can be handled by a citation worded narrowly around the two-dimensional quantum spin Hall state, and the 2016 prize covered a distinct topic. P002 (twisted bilayer graphene) has a cleaner attribution but its mechanism and disorder effects are still argued after about eight years; P003 (optical lattice clock) is a clean attribution but a narrower footprint close to the 2005 and 2012 prizes. An award is preferable to no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile for P001, P002 or P003; my gamma-ray and hard-X-ray instrumentation ties (Fermi-LAT, PoGOLite/PoGO+, XL-Calibur) bear only on B031, which is not in the slate.
